text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about 5 hours a week. CRM updates went from end-of-day chores to same-day habits.

2. Quality beat speed. Summaries were only useful once we agreed on a template: pain, budget, next step.

3. Trust took work. Some customers hesitated until reps asked consent upfront and explained how notes were stored.

4. Managers coached better. Reading call summaries showed patterns no ride-along ever caught.

5. Noisy sites hurt accuracy. Plant floors and parking-lot calls still needed manual backup.

The biggest lesson: the tool didn't change results until we changed the workflow around it.
